items.title: Techno Lag
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: No need to restart your computer. It's these guys messing with your PC! Show your inner gamer with these glitchy heroes!

items.title: WIZARDS
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
The spell has been broken! The wizards have returned and ready for some action! Choose any of these magical wizard themed styles for your next Minecraft adventure.

- Wizard skins
- Great for roleplay

items.title: Anime Agents
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Time to go undercover with the Anime Agents!

Which agent will you choose?

items.title: Bedwars World
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Bedwars World is a fun mini-game for everyone! Protect your bed, collect resources, upgrade your weapons, and go to war!

- Original bedwars experience
- This world is made for multiplayer only

items.title: Bathtub Racing
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Race your friends or AI opponents in the funniest sport, Bathtub Racing! Go downhill at crazy speeds. Four zany courses filled with surprises and skillful turns. Take first place to win prizes, then spend coins on newer and cooler bathtubs.
- 4 racing tubs
- 4 race tracks above a large city
- Single and multiplayer fun

Creeper, Enderman, Chicken, and Zombie mob racers!

items.title: Robot Pets
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Upgrade animals into robot pets! Build a mech suit for a wolf and it will defend you with lasers. Auto-pigs chop down trees and other blocks. Robocows create mineshafts all the way down to bedrock. Robot Unicorns jump extra high.
- 7 animals to upgrade
- Also power-up boats, golems, and minecarts
- Infinite survival spawn
- 5 skins

Explore the world in a flying minecart!

items.title: Millionaire Party Mansion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Millionaire Party Mansion is a mansion with everything a millionaire needs! From fun rooms to a beautiful pool, this mansion has tons of stuff for you to share with your friends! Explore your mansion and enjoy all the luxury it has to offer.

- Mega mansion
- Modern design
- Great with friends!

items.title: Rich Gang
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Wanna drive millionaire cars and throw a party at your mansion? You can do all that and more with these awesome skins!

+ 10 skins
+ By Street Studios

items.title: Flower Onesies
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
The sun is out and flowers are showing their true colors! Enjoy this sweet-scented pack and represent some of the most colorful flowers on the planet. Or just look super cute!

-12 flower-themed, teen skins
-Includes skins for boys and girls
-1 free skin!

items.title: City Racers
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to get your name on the top of the scoreboard with these cool racer skins? It's time to get in your racecar and hit the gas with these skins!

+ Perfect for roleplay
+ 16 skins (2 FREE)
+ By Mirevon Studios

items.title: Pirates Steal
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Argh arghh, the pirates are angry. They are robbed of their treasures but they will not sit back. They will sail through the seven seas to find the culprit and take back what belongs to them.

- 21 epic pirate skins
+ 1 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Skyblock Animals
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Skyblock Animals is perfect for anyone looking for a unique and exciting experience. Travel from island to island to discover new resources, then journey to the Nether and End dimensions to find more animal islands and defeat the Ender Dragon!

- 10 overworld animal islands
- 3 Nether animal islands
- 3 End animal islands
- By ArgoStudios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Pirate Parkour
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
This exciting pirate adventurous parkour takes you from forgotten islands to pirate ships and equips you with various power-ups as you progress!
* Carefree skins included!
* Power-ups!
* Race your friends!
* Custom music tracks!
By Giggle Block Studios!

items.title: Neko Life
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Neko teens are among us! You can join them and look cute with lovely colors. Join your friends and walk around the city in a clowder. With colorful designs, cat ears, and modern styles you'll be fashionable with this pack!

+ 12 skins
+ 1 free skin

items.title: Fresh City Vibes
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Getting them fresh vibes from fresh clothes! What better way to flex your style with a fresh new outfit!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Inspired by a modern, luxury attire

items.title: Rainbow Teens
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
You like colors? Get rainbow skins to communicate your emotions to the world! Wear the colors of the rainbow and never have to choose what color to wear again!

+1 free skin
+ 10 rainbow skins

items.title: Pastel Rainbow Teens
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
See the rainbow, be the rainbow..? Take a step into a brighter life with the Pastel Rainbow Teens skin set, where you can shine bright and colorful with soft colors! Why pick one color when you can have them all!

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Hi-Bear-Nating
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
It's time for the bears to sleep, how about joining them for a long nap? Aren't you tired too? Make sure you act like one of them with the Hi-Bear-Nating skin pack, you might not get to hide away and sleep!

- 6 extra comfy skins!
- By 57Digital

items.title: Horsing Around
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Roleplay as one of these adorable horse skins! Which one will you pick?

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- Inspired by horses and cute costumes
- Grab the Gamer Horse skin for FREE
- By 57Digital

items.title: Shark Pirates
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Which is better: a pirate or a shark? Why not be both with a mix of the two! With the Shark Pirates skin pack, take control of the sea and make all the loot it comes with yours. Swim in the sea or sail on a ship, the seas are yours to explore!

- 6 grinning skins included
- By 57Digital

items.title: Secret Block Agents
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
First, you were a block... and now, you're a secret agent. Dip into the life of a myriad of spies with the new Secret Block Agents skin pack. Whether you're a helpful chest or a shimmering diamond block, anyone (or anything) can be a secret agent.

- 6 skins included
- Bring your own gadgets
- By 57Digital

items.title: Seasons
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Summer, winter, fall, spring... It's hard to choose which season is the best. Maybe a mix of two would be better? With the Seasons skin pack, you don't have to choose - your favorite season is there!

- 6 skins included
- By 57Digital

items.title: Secret Mob Agents
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Put on your bee mask and hide your spider identity, it's time to become a Secret Mob Agent. Take a step into the world of agents and spies, secrets and spookiness - whether you're a cow, a slime, or a particularly secretive pig, it's time to become the best agent you can be!

- 10 secret skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Animal PJ's
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Love comfy pajamas? Love animals even more? Then this skin pack is perfect for you! Whether you're a panda fan or a cat person, the Animal PJ's skin pack has the animal for you.

- 6 skins included
- Match with your favorite pet!
- By 57Digital
